messages:
maria: FYI customer 'FinLedger' opened a critical ticket — they can't open models or see billing. says console shows 403 on /models and /billing.

support-bot: Ticket #CL-4321 created and escalated to security.

maria: @sanjay can you check RBAC rollout from last night? we did the role rename for finance teams.

sanjay: looking. last night we rolled rbac change #RB-2029 that renamed org:billing_admin -> org:finance_admin and removed some implicit aliases. rolling diff now.

kevin: Pulling audit logs for finledger tenant id t-fnlg-09. one moment.

audit-bot: audit.log entries for t-fnlg-09 between 2026-03-20T01:00Z and 2026-03-20T02:00Z attached: 
 - 2026-03-20T01:12:34Z grantRole user=svc-deploy role=org:billing_admin -> SUCCESS
 - 2026-03-20T01:12:34Z updateRoleMapping admin=aj change=rename org:billing_admin -> org:finance_admin
 - 2026-03-20T01:13:01Z auth.failed user=alice@finledger reason=missing_permission resource=/models

maria: So the rename removed the old alias mapping; customers who were bound to org:billing_admin have no mapped role until migration script runs. @liz did we schedule migration for external tenants?

liz: we planned a DB migration but it was gated behind a feature flag and didn't run for external tenants. bug there.

maria: customer is locked out of models and billing, they can't deploy. We need temporary fix and a rollback plan.

sanjay: temp mitigation: add back an alias mapping from org:billing_admin -> org:finance_admin and grant back the previous permissions for affected tenants. I'll run a one-off mapping.

kevin: Confirmed affected identities for t-fnlg-09: alice@finledger (org-admin), bob@finledger (billing).

sanjay: Running mapping command now: 
```
rbacctl add-alias --from org:billing_admin --to org:finance_admin --tenant t-fnlg-09 --reason "emergency restore"
```

support-bot: rbacctl: alias added successfully (op 0x4f2a).

maria: customer reports console access back, can open models list but still 403 on billing invoices page.

kevin: Billing page 403 seems to come from call to /billing/invoices which requires permission billing.view_invoice scoped to role org:finance_admin. alias restores role, but permission table shows billing.view_invoice not assigned to finance_admin in current policy.

liz: I see the policy diff. when we refactored we accidentally removed the granular billing permissions and consolidated them under a new role org:billing_finance_read. Migration didn't add that role to tenants. here's the policy snippet we applied:
```
- role org:billing_admin {
-   allow: billing.*
- }
+ role org:finance_admin {
+   allow: models.read, models.write
+   # billing perms moved to org:billing_finance_read
+}
```

maria: ugh. so we need to grant billing.view_invoice to finledger immediately.

sanjay: Applying temp patch: 
```
rbacctl grant --role org:finance_admin --perm billing.view_invoice --tenant t-fnlg-09
```

support-bot: grant applied.

maria: customer confirms billing page loads and invoices visible :white_check_mark:

kevin: KMS check reminder — we rotated a KMS key for billing token signing earlier this week. did the rotation affect permissions on HSM-wrapped service accounts?

liz: rotation succeeded, but one service principal svc-billing-reader lost IAM binding to the new key due to template mismatch. I just re-granted decrypt/list permission.

audit-bot: note: KMS change KMS-117 applied 2026-03-18T23:00Z\. No decrypt errors recorded for t-fnlg-09 after permission update.

maria: customer back to normal. we need postmortem and follow-ups.

sanjay: Action items: 
- revert temp alias and apply correct migration script globally (RB-2029-migrate)
- add e2e test that verifies tenant-role aliasing when role renames occur
- add preflight check in rollout that ensures external tenants are covered by migrations
- add alert when role rename occurs without a migration mapping in service config

liz: I'll open a PR with migration script fix and tests, assign to @kevin for review.

kevin: creating PR now, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/pull/459

maria: I'll update customer ticket CL-4321 with timeline and mitigation steps and the rollback window for any config changes.

maria: Post-incident: mark as resolved when PR merged and migration run.

support-bot: Ticket #CL-4321 updated: status=waiting-on-deploy.

sanjay: Also adding a short-runbook step: when customers report both /models and /billing 403s after RBAC change, check alias mapping and billing granular permissions first.

maria: thanks team. please add time estimates to PR and migration so support can update SLA response times.

kevin: ETA for PR review + tests: 4h. migration rollout across tenants: 2h with canaries.

maria: last note — let's add an audit alert for large-scale role renames that affect >100 tenants. this would've caught the missing migration flag.

audit-bot: alert rule proposal created: alert/rbac-role-rename-unmapped.

maria: closing thread, will reopen if customer reports regression.
